The Sport & League Page Audit for bainluck.com is complete. Here are the key findings:

**Health Score: 45/100** — 13 of 15 pages have issues.

**Critical Findings:**
1. Cross-sport data contamination (MLS shows basketball/baseball records; Golf shows a squash player as Open Championship leader)

4. Navigation loops — "View full grid →" links back to the same page on every league
5. Missing game schedules — Only MLB and UFC show upcoming events; all other leagues lack game listings

**Best Performing Pages:** MLB (has games, futures, and excellent UX) and Golf (beautiful design with live events and countdown)
